objective: Research current frontend animations & effects best practices (baseline-aware against prior 20260922-animations-effects-transitions findings), then implement only NEW fitting DOs in the vanilla zero-build dashboard; verified no-op is an allowed outcome.
constraints: KEEP_VANILLA: no animation libraries, no bundlers, no GSAP/React/Tailwind
18 getElementById hooks + STATE_KEY "gate-earn-dashboard-v1" in app.js must remain intact (grep-verified)
prefers-reduced-motion kill-switch (~styles.css:2243+) must cover ALL new motion
one orchestrated motion moment only (dial-draw load sequence); load sequence budget <=800ms
single ease token cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1); entrances composite-only (transform/opacity)
lift policy: ONLY .top3-card and .pws-link may translateY(-1px); nothing else gains a lift
no will-change sprinkling, no animation-timeline, no scattered hover-lift
a11y: 44px targets, focus-visible gold ring, keyboard-operable controls, AA contrast
ASCII-only edits except existing Rs symbol
out of scope: date changes, color-scheme changes, content/copy changes
verification allowed: npx prettier --check index.html styles.css app.js; npx tsc --allowJs --checkJs false --noEmit app.js; npx eslint app.js; git status/diff/log/add/commit
verification DENIED: node --check, stylelint, python, &&-chained commands
